from allocation.domain import model
from allocation.adapters import repository


def allocate(line: model.OrderLine, repo: repository.AbstractRepository) -> str:
    batches = repo.list()
    if not batches:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Out of stock for sku {line.sku}")
    batch = min(batches, key=lambda item: item.eta or model.date.min)
    batch.allocate(line)
    return batch.reference

from flask import Flask, jsonify, request

from allocation.domain import model
from allocation.service_layer import services


app = Flask(__name__)


@app.post("/allocate")
def allocate_endpoint():
    line = model.OrderLine(request.json["orderid"], request.json["sku"], request.json["qty"])
    batchref = services.allocate(line, repo=get_repository())
    return jsonify({"batchref": batchref}), 201

from datetime import date

from allocation.domain import model


def test_allocating_to_a_batch_reduces_available_quantity():
    batch = model.Batch("batch-001", "SMALL-TABLE", qty=20, eta=date.today())
    line = model.OrderLine("order-ref", "SMALL-TABLE", 2)

    batch.allocate(line)

    assert batch.available_quantity == 18
